[RDSC.4a.6.3] **An `AlphaNode` names its schema.** Its `schema_name` is the
name of the schema whose facts it filters, and is never empty. A loader **must**
refuse an `AlphaNode` whose `schema_name` is empty with `DS_ERR_DSC_SEMANTIC`
([RDSC.11.1]). The refusal belongs to the body's shape ([RDSC.8.7]), so the
loader makes it before it looks any name up: an empty name is no name to look
up, and is never `DS_ERR_DSC_DANGLING`.
